items.ruling: The desktop window must show its whole guided flow at its minimum size — QR, its instructions, the settings card, the buttons and the update button — with nothing overlapping, nothing cut off, and no starved empty holes.

Every row of the phone's layout list is readable: the row's icon is a small badge, and no word is broken across lines by an oversized icon. (This panel was 5/10 an hour earlier — 'Desktop' split into 'Deskt/op' by a full-height monitor icon.)

Creating a layout asks the user NOTHING about which app shortcuts it carries — the PC recognises the app by itself. The panel holds only: the chosen window, the Name field, the grid mode, the orientation and Cancel/Create.
Renaming a layout asks only for the name — no app-shortcut ticks.
The Move handle is a clearly hittable drawn four-way arrow at the centre of the region, and the whole panel fits the phone card.
The wheel-set picker states its own cap honestly and every row is readable: ticks on the left, the live 'ON THE WHEEL NOW' badge legible against its background.
The traffic window's numbers, graph and legend are all readable at its minimum size.
